daas-irab:1-5.t: ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; ﴿النَّازِعاتِ﴾: the thing sworn by, genitive (majrūr); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb of swearing; ﴿غَرْقاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالنَّاشِطاتِ نَشْطاً﴾, ﴿وَالسَّابِحاتِ سَبْحاً﴾, ﴿فَالسَّابِقاتِ سَبْقاً﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَالْمُدَبِّراتِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿أَمْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:6-9.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تَتْبَعُهَا﴾: an imperfect verb and its object; ﴿الرَّادِفَةُ﴾: its agent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قُلُوبٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb annexed to one like it; ﴿واجِفَةٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective) of قلوب; ﴿أَبْصارُها خاشِعَةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of قلوب, and the clause قلوب… is resumptive.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم يقولون". ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle, and inna and its noun; ﴿لَمَرْدُودُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and its khabar; ﴿فِي الْحافِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; the nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying.

daas-irab:11-14.t: ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle, and ﴿إِذا﴾ is a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿كُنَّا عِظاماً﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); ﴿نَخِرَةً﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إِذاً﴾: a particle of answer and requital with no governing effect; ﴿كَرَّةٌ﴾: khabar; ﴿خاسِرَةٌ﴾: adjective; the nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained one (makfūfa), and the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; ﴿واحِدَةٌ﴾: adjective; the nominal clause is the maqūl of an omitted verb of saying, and the discourse is resumptive. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and ﴿إذا﴾ is the particle of surprise (fujāʾiyya); ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ; ﴿بِالسَّاهِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar.

daas-irab:15-17.t: ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle; ﴿أَتاكَ﴾: a past verb and its object; ﴿حَدِيثُ﴾: fāʿil (agent); ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿ناداهُ رَبُّهُ﴾: a past verb, its object and its agent; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ﴿بِالْوادِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿الْمُقَدَّسِ﴾: naʿt (adjective); ﴿طُوىً﴾: badal (substitute) for الوادي. ﴿اذْهَبْ﴾: an imperative verb whose agent is latent (mustatir); the clause is explicative of the calling; ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: inna and its noun; ﴿طَغى﴾: a past verb whose agent is latent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:18-19.t: ﴿فَقُلْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿هَلْ﴾: an interrogative particle; ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: "هل لك سبيل" (have you a way). ﴿إِلى﴾: a preposition; ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative; ﴿تَزَكَّى﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an, its agent latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of a genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted mubtadaʾ; the implied nominal clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying.

daas-irab:20-23.t: ﴿فَأَراهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its first object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); ﴿الْآيَةَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿الْكُبْرى﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَكَذَّبَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose agent is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿وَعَصى﴾: conjoined to كذب. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction; ﴿أَدْبَرَ﴾: a past verb whose agent is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿يَسْعى﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَحَشَرَ فَنادى﴾: both conjoined to what precedes them.

daas-irab:24-26.t: ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is the maqūl (speech content) of the saying. ﴿فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿نَكالَ الْآخِرَةِ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), muḍāf to الآخرة; ﴿الْأُولى﴾: conjoined to الآخرة. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters); ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: the fronted khabar of inna; ﴿لَعِبْرَةً﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the postponed noun of inna; the nominal clause is resumptive; ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of عبرة; ﴿يَخْشى﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من.

daas-irab:27-29.t: ﴿أَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle; ﴿أَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive; ﴿خَلْقاً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿أَمِ﴾: a conjunction; ﴿السَّماءُ﴾: mubtadaʾ, its khabar omitted; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بَناها﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَفَعَ﴾: a past verb whose agent is latent; ﴿سَمْكَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is explicative. ﴿فَسَوَّاها﴾: a past verb and its object, the agent being latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَها﴾: a past verb and its object, the agent being latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحاها﴾: conjoined to أغطش ليلها.

daas-irab:30-33.t:
﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it; ﴿بَعْدَ ذلِكَ﴾: an adverb of time, muḍāf to ذلك. ﴿دَحاها﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is explicative. ﴿أَخْرَجَ﴾: a past verb whose agent is latent; ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; ﴿ماءَها﴾: direct object; ﴿وَمَرْعاها﴾: conjoined to ماءها; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْجِبالَ أَرْساها﴾: parsed like the preceding one.
﴿مَتاعاً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to what precedes them; ﴿وَلِأَنْعامِكُمْ﴾: conjoined to لكم.

daas-irab:34-36.t: ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is a conditional adverb that does not put the verb in the jussive; ﴿جاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted; ﴿الْكُبْرى﴾: naʿt (adjective) of الطامة; the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time, badal (substitute) for إذا; ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسانُ﴾: a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; يتذكر is an imperfect verb] and its agent; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation; ﴿ما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿سَعى﴾: a past verb whose agent is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَبُرِّزَتِ﴾: a passive past verb; ﴿الْجَحِيمُ﴾: its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; ﴿يَرى﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is latent; the clause is the ṣila of من.

daas-irab:37-39.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and ﴿أما﴾ is a particle of condition and detailing; ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿طَغى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من; ﴿وَآثَرَ﴾: conjoined to طغى; ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa), and inna and its noun; ﴿هِيَ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); ﴿الْمَأْوى﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna; the nominal clause is the khabar of من.

daas-irab:40-41.t: The two verses are conjoined to what precedes them, and their i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:42-45.t: ﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; ﴿عَنِ السَّاعَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَيَّانَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as an adverb of time, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿مُرْساها﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the second object of يسألونك. ﴿فِيمَ﴾: fronted khabar; ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿مِنْ ذِكْراها﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكَ﴾: fronted khabar; ﴿مُنْتَهاها﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained one (makfūfa); ﴿أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive; ﴿مَنْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿يَخْشاها﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, the agent being latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿كَأَنَّهُمْ﴾: كأن and its noun; ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿يَرَوْنَها﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, the wāw being its agent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of كأن, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿عَشِيَّةً﴾: an adverb of time; ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction; ﴿ضُحاها﴾: conjoined to عشية.
